description: This file implements a trading strategy using Isolation Forest for anomaly detection, including classes for the model and strategy, and a backtesting engine using the backtrader library.

classes.name: IsolationModel
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the Isolation Forest model for anomaly detection.

classes.name: IsolationStrategy
classes.description: A backtrader strategy class that uses Isolation Forest to generate trading signals based on anomaly detection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the IsolationModel with data, normalizing it and fitting the Isolation Forest.

methods.name: predict_outlier
methods.description: Predicts whether data points are outliers using the fitted Isolation Forest.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamps during strategy execution.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Defines the trading logic executed on each new data point, including anomaly detection and trade execution.

methods.name: backtesting_engine
methods.description: Sets up and runs a backtest of the specified trading strategy over a date range.
